ENFJ>INTJ.title: Drawing up everyone's future, alone in a quiet room.
ENFJ>INTJ.body: You plan for everyone alone in a quiet room, then present it on the big day with more fire than anyone. That picture suits you. Seeing ahead and laying out a path is the steady ground under both your nature and the way you've grown. You can switch between the spark you get from people and the focus you find alone, between reading feelings and deciding by logic.
ENFJ>INTJ.say: "I've already mapped out the whole flow. …Just tell me if everyone can keep up without strain."
ENFJ>INTJ.do: You work late into the night on the team's long-term plan, then share it the next morning with a personal note for each member.
ENFJ>INTJ.worry: The more efficient the idea, the more you worry it leaves someone's feelings behind, so you can't commit. Some days you want to see everyone and some days no one, and the swing throws even you off.
ENFJ>INTJ.karai: Your five-year plan is flawless. Your plans for this weekend? Still blank.

ENFJ>INTP.title: You cheer people up — and take their problem apart while you're at it.
ENFJ>INTP.body: While someone pours their heart out, you lift their spirits and somehow end up sketching a diagram of the problem. A curious kind of good listener. Trusting ideas and possibilities is the thread that runs through both sides of you. Energy from people and time lost in thought, a warm heart and a logical head, planning and going with the flow — you hold almost all of it in both hands.
ENFJ>INTP.say: "That sounds really hard. So, why did it happen? Mind if I draw it out?"
ENFJ>INTP.do: On the way home from hearing a friend's worries, you come up with three theories for fixing it and quietly text them the next day.
ENFJ>INTP.worry: Wanting to help people and wanting to chase your own interests pull on you equally, and you're never sure where your time should go. You can't move until your thoughts settle, yet the faces of the people waiting keep flickering in your mind.
ENFJ>INTP.karai: Words of encouragement for others come out instantly. Your own replies sit for three days.

ENFJ>ENTJ.title: Decisive in the room, thoughtful after. The leader people lean on.
ENFJ>ENTJ.body: You set the goal and pull everyone forward, yet you stop and check on anyone falling behind. That kind of leader fits you well. Drawing energy from people, picturing what's ahead and moving with a plan have been consistent in you from the start. Because you can both feel each person's mood and decide with clear logic, there's always warmth inside your toughness.
ENFJ>ENTJ.say: "The deadline is Friday, no wiggle room. If anyone's struggling, tell me now."
ENFJ>ENTJ.do: After cutting straight to a decision in a meeting, you send a private thank-you only to the person who seemed down.
ENFJ>ENTJ.worry: You made the right call, yet at night you replay it, wondering if someone got hurt. When you should be firm, one look at the other person's face and your words go soft.
ENFJ>ENTJ.karai: Team morale: boosted. Your own energy budget: doesn't add up.

ENFJ>ENTP.title: Turning the idea nobody saw coming into one everyone can join.
ENFJ>ENTP.body: "What if we flip it?" is your catchphrase. You liven up a discussion, pull out an idea no one else thought of, and then shape it so everyone can get on board. Feeling alive around people and spotting new possibilities have always been part of you. You also move freely between caring about feelings and testing logic, between planning ahead and jumping on a whim.
ENFJ>ENTP.say: "What if we looked at it backwards? …In a way nobody loses out, of course."
ENFJ>ENTP.do: A conversation you meant as small talk sparks a new project, and you've assigned roles before it ends.
ENFJ>ENTP.worry: You want to push your idea forward, but you understand how the people against it feel, and that hits the brakes. The moment you make a plan, a more interesting approach pops up and you can't sit still.
ENFJ>ENTP.karai: The person who got the debate going is the first one off on a tangent.

ENFJ>INFJ.title: Words that reach the heart, on a stage or one-on-one.
ENFJ>INFJ.body: In front of a crowd you lift everyone up; one-on-one you listen deeply. You can gently put words to feelings the other person hadn't even noticed. Picturing what's ahead, caring about feelings and moving with a plan — that's your core. With the energy you get from people and the calm you find alone, you can move between lively rooms and quiet ones.
ENFJ>INFJ.say: "Let's all talk! But first, can I hear just your thoughts?"
ENFJ>INFJ.do: After hosting an event with a smile, you make a cup of tea at home and go over, one by one, what each person said to you.
ENFJ>INFJ.worry: The days you've helped the most are the days you come home drained. You take others' worries so deeply to heart that your own heart gets heavy too.
ENFJ>INFJ.karai: You read every subtle shift in people's hearts, but miss your own battery running low.

ENFJ>INFP.title: Pushing others forward with all your might, waiting patiently on your own heart.
ENFJ>INFP.body: When it's for someone else, you're surprisingly quick to act. When it's for you, you can wait patiently until your heart says, "This is it." That's your unexpected side. Trusting ideas and caring deeply about feelings is the part of you that never wavers. You can also draw on both energy from people and depth alone, both planning and going with the flow.
ENFJ>INFP.say: "That's so lovely! …Let me check in with my own heart about it, too."
ENFJ>INFP.do: You cheer on a friend's dream and even help plan it, while your own dream stays carefully tucked in your journal.
ENFJ>INFP.worry: Wanting to meet people's hopes and wanting to stay true to your heart both matter, and you freeze when you have to choose. Even with a plan, on days your heart isn't in it you can't start, and you're hard on yourself for it.
ENFJ>INFP.karai: You push everyone else's back at full force, but yours has a little sign on it: "Not ready yet."

ENFJ>ENFJ.title: You've grown your gift for bringing out the best in people, straight and true.
ENFJ>ENFJ.body: When you say "You can do it," you truly believe it. Believing in people, standing by their feelings and getting everyone facing the same way — what you were born with and what you've lived through have drawn this into one clear line. You shine where you can help, and where you can't see how people respond, you tend to lose steam without knowing why.
ENFJ>ENFJ.say: "It's okay, you can do this. Let's do it together!"
ENFJ>ENFJ.do: At a gathering full of strangers, you end up introducing everyone to each other, and by the time you leave, you've started a group chat.
ENFJ>ENFJ.worry: When people count on you, you take on everything, and your time for yourself quietly disappears. If the mood around you clouds over even a little, you start wondering if it's your fault.
ENFJ>ENFJ.karai: You wish so hard for everyone's happiness that you forget to save a slice for yourself.

ENFJ>ENFP.title: A careful planner who still laughs at every surprise.
ENFJ>ENFP.body: You'll write "free time — decide on the spot" right into the itinerary. A playful kind of organizer. Drawing energy from people, trusting ideas and deciding with your heart have stayed the same from birth until now. Since you can both plan ahead and flex with the moment, the world of everyone around you naturally grows bigger.
ENFJ>ENFP.say: "I put together everyone's plans for next month! …But don't you suddenly want to go to the beach that day?"
ENFJ>ENFP.do: You plan a birthday party down to the minute, then throw yourself into whatever game someone dreams up on the day.
ENFJ>ENFP.worry: Wanting people to be happy, you pack the schedule, and suddenly your free time is gone. The gap between days you want order and days you want nothing decided confuses even you.
ENFJ>ENFP.karai: On the "let's just wing it" trip, guess who did the most research? You.

ENFJ>ISTJ.title: Quietly adding kindness to a very precise manual.
ENFJ>ISTJ.body: People often see you as "the meticulous one," but your precision is always about not leaving anyone stuck. Seeing things through to the end is the pillar your nature and character share. Energy from people and focus alone, a feel for what's ahead and solid facts, kindness and fairness — you carry all of them.
ENFJ>ISTJ.say: "Please follow these steps. I'll check in with the new folks myself."
ENFJ>ISTJ.do: You finish a flawless handover document, then add handwritten notes only where the reader might trip up.
ENFJ>ISTJ.worry: Wanting people to follow the rules and not wanting to blame them collide, and you rewrite your reminder again and again. You want to see people, but if you're not fully prepared, you're tired before you even meet.
ENFJ>ISTJ.karai: You're trying to add kindness to the manual, too.

ENFJ>ISFJ.title: The cheerleader in front, the one who remembers everyone's tastes behind the scenes.
ENFJ>ISFJ.body: She doesn't like spicy food, he had a little cough yesterday — you just remember these things. Caring about feelings and moving with a plan is the part of you that stays the same. With energy from people and calm alone, a feel for possibilities and a careful eye for facts, you play both the bright cheerleader and the attentive helper.
ENFJ>ISFJ.say: "You were coughing yesterday, right? I brought you some throat drops."
ENFJ>ISFJ.do: You take charge of a farewell party and pick the restaurant by recalling the guest of honor's favorite foods from years of conversations.
ENFJ>ISFJ.worry: Helping others never feels like a burden, yet your own plans always end up last in line. Some days you want to talk about big dreams, but you stop yourself with "I need to be realistic."
ENFJ>ISFJ.karai: Everyone's anniversaries are in your planner. Your own birthday? Someone has to remind you.

ENFJ>ESTJ.title: A tough boss everyone loves, because you never miss a win.
ENFJ>ESTJ.body: You track the numbers on the progress chart and jot down each member's small wins right next to them. People love you even when you're strict, because you truly see their effort. Drawing energy from people and moving with a set plan point the same way in both your nature and character. You use imagination and real-world follow-through, warmth and fair logic, without letting go of either.
ENFJ>ESTJ.say: "Let's hit this number by the end of the month. …Your slides last week were so clear, by the way."
ENFJ>ESTJ.do: At the end of a meeting you read out the decisions, then close by naming each person's "great play of the week."
ENFJ>ESTJ.worry: Should you speak up to someone breaking the rules, or put their feelings first? Each time, it wears you down. The more realistically you move forward, the further you feel from the dream you once had.
ENFJ>ESTJ.karai: You manage the team's schedule to the minute, but your own break is marked "if there's time."

ENFJ>ESFJ.title: Caring about next year's dream and today's lunch alike.
ENFJ>ESFJ.body: Right after pitching a big idea for next year, you ask, "Did everyone eat lunch?" That's why you're the center of calm at any gathering. Drawing energy from people, caring about feelings and moving with a plan has always been your core. A feel for what can't be seen yet and a respect for experience and facts each show up when needed.
ENFJ>ESFJ.say: "Let's do something even bigger next year!"
ENFJ>ESFJ.do: You volunteer for the neighborhood festival, pitch something new, and still pass on every trick that worked last year.
ENFJ>ESFJ.worry: You want everyone to be happy so badly that one unhappy face keeps your heart from resting. You're pulled both by wanting to try new things and by wanting to protect the way things work.
ENFJ>ESFJ.karai: By the time you've handed everyone a plate, your own food has gone cold.

ENFJ>ISTP.title: Few words, but the one you say when it counts is full of heat.
ENFJ>ISTP.body: You're a calm doer who doesn't say much and fixes problems fast. You also carry a warmth that wants people to grow and wants to cheer them on. With a side that comes alive around people and a side that works quietly alone, a heart for feelings and a head that cuts to the point, your hands move before your words, and you finish with one short, warm line.
ENFJ>ISTP.say: "It's no big deal. …But I think you can do even better."
ENFJ>ISTP.do: You quietly fix a junior's mistake without a word, then later just say, "You were on the right track."
ENFJ>ISTP.worry: You want to encourage people, but saying it feels awkward, so you let your actions do the talking. You move so much for others that your own time can vanish.
ENFJ>ISTP.karai: Cool face on, you're keeping a secret growth diary for your junior in your head.

ENFJ>ISFP.title: Kind words and handmade gifts — you give both easily.
ENFJ>ISFP.body: Words that lift everyone up and a small gift you chose on your own — both come naturally. Deciding with your heart is the thread that ties who you were born as to who you are. Energy from people and comfort alone, a feel for the future and a taste for beauty right in front of you, planning and following your mood — you have both of each.
ENFJ>ISFP.say: "Doesn't this flower's color look like today's sky?"
ENFJ>ISFP.do: You organize a group message card for a friend's birthday, and quietly add a little trinket you picked out yourself.
ENFJ>ISFP.worry: The more you plan to meet everyone's hopes, the more your heart lags behind. You love a lively crowd, but afterward you need quiet time alone to feel like yourself again.
ENFJ>ISFP.karai: You're first to notice how others feel, and last to notice you're tired.

ENFJ>ESTP.title: Getting everyone fired up, then diving in first.
ENFJ>ESTP.body: "Call first, think later" is your motto when it matters. You talk up everyone's dream until they're on board, then you're the first to jump in and clear the way. Drawing energy from people is the part of you that never wavers. You switch between seeing the future and grabbing what's real, kindness and clean decisions, planning and pure momentum.
ENFJ>ESTP.say: "Okay, I'm calling them before I overthink it."
ENFJ>ESTP.do: The moment after hearing a friend's problem, you're already reaching out to someone who might solve it.
ENFJ>ESTP.worry: After deciding on impulse, you look back to check whether anyone got left behind. Wanting to plan carefully and wanting to move right now fight it out, and you end up thinking on the run.
ENFJ>ESTP.karai: No one thinks about people's feelings more than you, but you move so fast nobody can keep up.

ENFJ>ESFP.title: Head cheerleader for everyone's future, and the one having the most fun today.
ENFJ>ESFP.body: You truly cheer on everyone's future while making the moment in front of you wonderfully fun. Drawing energy from people and deciding with your heart have always been part of you. With both a feel for future possibilities and a love of right now, both planning ahead and enjoying whatever comes, the people near you can't help but smile.
ENFJ>ESFP.say: "Let's make all your dreams come true! …But today, let's just have a blast!"
ENFJ>ESFP.do: You throw a party to cheer on a friend's challenge, and on the day, forget about hosting and have the most fun of anyone.
ENFJ>ESFP.worry: You want to protect the fun, then suddenly worry about what's ahead. You get so caught up in making people happy that your own true feelings get pushed back.
ENFJ>ESFP.karai: Passionate about everyone's life plans — and looking the other way from your own wallet.

ENFP>INTJ.title: Five seconds after an idea, you're drawing the blueprint.
ENFP>INTJ.body: You don't let an exciting idea stay a daydream. Before you know it, you've quietly drawn up the full plan. Trusting ideas and possibilities is the unchanging thread in both your nature and character. Energy from people and depth alone, heart and logic, freedom and a clear plan — you carry every one of them.
ENFP>INTJ.say: "This is going to be amazing! So I made a three-phase plan."
ENFP>INTJ.do: A hobby you started on a whim turns into a solo research project, complete with your own how-to guide.
ENFP>INTJ.worry: The idea takes a second, but making it a perfect plan takes forever before you start. The gap between days you want company and days you want no one around can puzzle people.
ENFP>INTJ.karai: Five seconds after the idea, you're already counting its three flaws.

ENFP>INTP.title: Curiosity in human form — digging deep with friends or alone.
ENFP>INTP.body: It starts with "Hey, isn't this interesting?" and ends with you researching alone past midnight. Trusting ideas and staying flexible have always been your ground. You move, depending on the day, between growing ideas with others and digging into how things work alone, between a heart for feelings and a head for logic.
ENFP>INTP.say: "Hey, isn't this fun? …Wait, let me figure out why it's fun."
ENFP>INTP.do: A question that came up while talking with friends keeps you researching alone until late at night.
ENFP>INTP.worry: Your interests keep moving, so it's hard to feel you've finished anything. After saying something logically right, you wonder if you left the other person's feelings behind.
ENFP>INTP.karai: So many search tabs open that you forget what you wanted to know.

ENFP>ENTJ.title: The leader who brings both the fun and the results.
ENFP>ENTJ.body: You share a dream that gets everyone excited, then right away set the roles and deadlines. That speed is what surprises people. Drawing energy from people and trusting ideas are the same in your nature and who you are now. With heart and logic, quick moves and solid plans, you turn a dream straight into a goal.
ENFP>ENTJ.say: "This would be so fun with everyone! Deadline's end of next month. Let's split the roles."
ENFP>ENTJ.do: An idea from a coffee-break chat becomes a proposal and schedule you share the very next morning.
ENFP>ENTJ.worry: The harder you push for results, the fewer happy faces you seem to see, and that gets you down. You're pulled both ways: sticking to the plan, and taking a fun detour.
ENFP>ENTJ.karai: The one who said "let's keep it fun" is chasing the numbers hardest.

ENFP>ENTP.title: Giving every idea a kind word and a sharp question at once.
ENFP>ENTP.body: You don't stop at ideas: you ask both "Who'll love this?" and "Will it actually work?" by yourself. Finding fun things fast and moving on the spot have always been yours. Because you can feel others' hearts and also tighten the logic, your debates are sharp but leave a kind aftertaste.
ENFP>ENTP.say: "That's fun! But hold on, there might be a hole."
ENFP>ENTP.do: While helping a friend with a problem, you end up offering three ways to improve things.
ENFP>ENTP.worry: After winning an argument, you remember the other person's face and feel low. Truth or kindness — which to put first? You hesitate every time.
ENFP>ENTP.karai: The one who takes the most damage after winning the argument? Usually you.

ENFP>INFJ.title: Friends with everyone, with a quiet conviction deep inside.
ENFP>INFJ.body: You warm up to anyone in no time, yet remember a passing comment for days. Behind the cheerfulness is a surprisingly deep gaze. Picturing possibilities and deciding with your heart is your core. You have both energy from people and calm alone, both a free spirit and a steady pull toward your goals.
ENFP>INFJ.say: "Oh, that's lovely! Hey, what does it mean to you?"
ENFP>INFJ.do: In the middle of a fun chat, you catch a small remark someone lets slip, and check on them gently a few days later.
ENFP>INFJ.worry: You want to act on an idea right away, but stop to ask, "Is this right?" You love meeting people, but after getting close, you need time alone.
ENFP>INFJ.karai: You make friends with anyone, but the door to your heart has three locks.

ENFP>INFP.title: Growing what moves you, out loud and in quiet.
ENFP>INFP.body: In a lively crowd you're the loudest voice, and alone you write the most delicate words. Having both is why you're so good at sharing what you feel. Trusting ideas, caring about feelings and following your heart have been part of you from the start. You move back and forth between energy from people and depth found alone.
ENFP>INFP.say: "Hey, hey, listen! Oh, but I can't put it into words yet. Can I write it down first?"
ENFP>INFP.do: Heading home after a day out with a big group, you pop in earbuds and jot down the best moments of the day.
ENFP>INFP.worry: Your waves of wanting company and wanting solitude are big, and some days a plan you made starts to feel heavy. You love so many things, but tend to move on before they take shape.
ENFP>INFP.karai: You say "I'm in!" right away, then regret it alone the night before.

ENFP>ENFJ.title: Pulling people in on a whim, and seeing it all the way through.
ENFP>ENFJ.body: A surprise you dream up gets everyone's schedules lined up the same day. You end up at the center because you don't stop at saying "let's do it." Drawing energy from people, trusting ideas and deciding with your heart match in both your nature and character. You also have both the freedom to move and the drive to plan and finish.
ENFP>ENFJ.say: "This would be so fun with everyone! …Okay, I'll be the organizer."
ENFP>ENFJ.do: A week after saying "I want to go camping," you're handing everyone a packing list and job assignments.
ENFP>ENFJ.worry: The more you're put in charge, the less time you have to act on a whim. Your sense of duty is strong, so even on days you're not feeling it, you hold on to every plan.
ENFP>ENFJ.karai: The self-declared free spirit is, as always, the one running the group calendar.

ENFP>ENFP.title: Official finder of fun, on yet another detour today.
ENFP>ENFP.body: You hop off at a station you've never seen and come home friends with a shop owner. Days like that suit you. Getting excited about new things, believing in people and widening your world by heart — what you were born with and what you've lived have grown it in the same direction. You shine where you're free, and somehow wilt in places full of rules and routine.
ENFP>ENFP.say: "Wait, what's that? Sounds fun! Let's go!"
ENFP>ENFP.do: Chatting about the neighborhood bakery's new bread somehow ends with you planning the next event with the owner.
ENFP>ENFP.worry: You love starting things, and you're hard on yourself when they don't last. You look cheerful, but sometimes a passing comment cuts you deeply.
ENFP>ENFP.karai: A hundred things on your bucket list. Three checked off.

ENFP>ISTJ.title: So proper, and so surprisingly fun to talk to.
ENFP>ISTJ.body: The report is done right on deadline, yet there's a little playful touch hiding on the last page. The sincerity to do what's decided with precision lives side by side with a curiosity that lights up at new possibilities. Focus alone and fun with others, an eye for facts and a heart for feelings, keeping plans and acting on a whim — you have all of them.
ENFP>ISTJ.say: "Let's follow the steps. By the way, I came up with something really fun lately."
ENFP>ISTJ.do: You take the same route to work every day, but on days off you head out on a whim to towns you've never seen.
ENFP>ISTJ.worry: You get everything done properly, yet when every day feels the same, something seems missing. You want to try your ideas, but "What if it fails?" makes you overly careful.
ENFP>ISTJ.karai: Taking meeting notes with a serious face — and three new project ideas in the margins.

ENFP>ISFJ.title: A fun idea, with a rainy-day plan attached.
ENFP>ISFJ.body: When you think of a picnic, you look up a rainy-day spot too, just in case. Even with fun plans, you check "Is everyone okay?" before you move. Deciding with your heart is the part of you that stays the same. Energy from people and calm alone, an eye for the new and care with facts, lightness and loyalty — you have both of each.
ENFP>ISFJ.say: "Sounds fun! …Oh, but is she free that day?"
ENFP>ISFJ.do: You're tempted to pick a bold gift for a friend, but in the end you carefully choose something they'll really use.
ENFP>ISFJ.worry: You want to dive into new things, but worrying about bothering others keeps you from taking the step. When asked, you say yes, and your own fun gets pushed back.
ENFP>ISFJ.karai: Full of the urge for adventure — and ordering the usual, at the usual place.

ENFP>ESTJ.title: Tight on plans, generous with play.
ENFP>ESTJ.body: You set the plan and lead the way, while slipping in little detours that brighten the room. A fun kind of organizer. Drawing energy from people is your steady core. Imagination and real-world follow-through, heart and logic, freedom and sticking to the plan — you have both of each.
ENFP>ESTJ.say: "Meet at nine, nobody late! And for lunch, let's try a new place."
ENFP>ESTJ.do: You lock down how the work gets done, then hide a little quiz in every weekly team meeting.
ENFP>ESTJ.worry: The more responsibility you're given, the more you feel you're forgetting the joy of acting on a whim. After calling someone out by the rules, you can't stop wondering if they're feeling down.
ENFP>ESTJ.karai: Five minutes after "let's play it by ear," you're handing out step-by-step instructions.

ENFP>ESFJ.title: Fresh ideas and careful attention, delivered together.
ENFP>ESFJ.body: "Let's do something different this year!" is usually your line. And on the day, you're quietly making sure no one is left out. Drawing energy from people and deciding with your heart have been the same from birth until now. Your feel for new possibilities and respect for experience, your lightness and your loyalty all stay alive.
ENFP>ESFJ.say: "I'll book the seats and food. The rest is a surprise!"
ENFP>ESFJ.do: You suggest a new game at a class reunion, and later send photos and updates to those who couldn't make it.
ENFP>ESFJ.worry: You want everyone to be happy so much that if a new idea gets a lukewarm reaction, you pull it right away. Adventure and the comfort of the usual both matter, and you go back and forth.
ENFP>ESFJ.karai: You planned the surprise, then got nervous and checked with the guest of honor first.

ENFP>ISTP.title: A light-footed experimenter who tries it now and fixes it calmly.
ENFP>ISTP.body: Before reading the manual, you take it apart. If it doesn't work, you calmly find the cause and fix it. Adapting flexibly to the moment is the part of you that never wavers. Energy from people and deep focus alone, a feel for possibilities and an eye for facts, a heart for feelings and a head for logic — you have both of each.
ENFP>ISTP.say: "Eh, I'll find out once I try it."
ENFP>ISTP.do: When a friend mentions their bike is squeaking, you crouch down right there and fix it in five minutes.
ENFP>ISTP.worry: Your waves of wanting fun with people and wanting to work quietly alone are big, and you worry people think you're antisocial. Showing feelings through action is easier than words, so you can be misunderstood.
ENFP>ISTP.karai: You feel for people's problems, but all that comes out of your mouth is solutions.

ENFP>ISFP.title: Loving the laughter of a crowd and the quiet of being alone.
ENFP>ISFP.body: After a big laugh with friends, you slip away to photograph a flower by the road. That's so you. Caring about feelings and following your heart is the part of you that stays the same. Energy from people and comfort alone, imagination for the unseen and a love of the colors, sounds and textures right in front of you — they all live together in you.
ENFP>ISFP.say: "Hey, look at this view! …Actually, let's not talk. I just want to look for a while."
ENFP>ISFP.do: You visit a museum with friends, and on the way out go back alone to stand in front of the same painting for thirty minutes.
ENFP>ISFP.worry: Wanting to connect and wanting to keep your own pace are both strong, so turning down an invite always stings a little. You love so many things, but get stuck when asked about future goals.
ENFP>ISFP.karai: Everyone's smiling in your photos, but your camera roll is mostly sky and cats.

ENFP>ESTP.title: Off the moment the idea hits, doing the math on the way.
ENFP>ESTP.body: The moment you hear there are no weekend plans, you've picked where to go. People think of you as "the one who always makes something happen." Drawing energy from people and moving with the moment are shared by your nature and character. With imagination and a grip on reality, heart and a clean cut, you jump in and still weigh what's worth it.
ENFP>ESTP.say: "Hey, we could go right now! That place is pricey though, let's pick another."
ENFP>ESTP.do: Five minutes after a friend sighs "I'm bored," the two of you are in line at the new bowling alley.
ENFP>ESTP.worry: After deciding on impulse, you worry whether you left someone's feelings behind. Chasing fun, your prep for what's next always ends up last-minute.
ENFP>ESTP.karai: On days you head out "just for a bit," you usually catch the last train home.

ENFP>ESFP.title: A trip around the world and today's crepe — you mean both.
ENFP>ESFP.body: You make people laugh with dreamy stories and still savor today's meal and view. The days of the people with you get a little brighter. Drawing energy from people, caring about feelings and moving with the moment are the parts that never shake. You have both imagination for what's ahead and a love of fun right now.
ENFP>ESFP.say: "Let's travel the world someday! …But today, let's go get that crepe!"
ENFP>ESFP.do: Heading home after talking about the future, you get swept right into a festival you spot along the way.
ENFP>ESFP.worry: There's so much fun that money and time always run short. Because you look so cheerful, it's a little lonely when no one notices you're down.
ENFP>ESFP.karai: Your dreams for the future are huge. Tomorrow's breakfast? Still undecided.
